
'''any-extended-rafsi''' is a [[jbocre: Morphology: f|fu'ivla]], a '''fu'ivla-rafsi''', a  '''stressed-fu'ivla-rafsi''', a '''brivla-rafsi''' or a '''stressed-brivla-rafsi'''.

A '''fu'ivla-rafsi''' consists of one or more [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nstressed-syllable]]s and a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables -syllable]] and possibly an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]], such that it starts with a non-[[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nset]], it doesn't start with a [[jbocre: Morphology: c|cmavo]], and it is not a y-final '''rafsi-string''' or a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''stressed-fu'ivla-rafsi''' consists of any number of [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nstressed-syllable]]s (possibly none), one [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed-syllable]] and then a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables -syllable]], such that it starts with a non-[[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nset]], it doesn't start with a [[jbocre: Morphology: c|cmavo]], and it is not a y-final '''rafsi-string''' or a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''brivla-rafsi''' consists of two or more [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nstressed-syllable]]s, an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]]), and a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels]] and possibly another [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]], such that it starts with a non-[[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nset]], it doesn't start with a [[jbocre: Morphology: c|cmavo]], and it is not a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''stressed-brivla-rafsi''' consists of one or more [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nstressed-syllable]]s, one [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed-syllable]] an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]]), and a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels]], such that it starts with a non-[[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nset]], it doesn't start with a [[jbocre: Morphology: c|cmavo]], and it is not a '''slinkujy'''.

A '''slinkujy''' is a  [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]] followed by a y-final '''rafsi-string'''

A y-final '''rafsi-string''' consists of any number of [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi -less-rafsi]] (possibly none) followed by a  [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi -rafsi]], a [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi tressed-y-rafsi]], a [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi tressed-y-less-rafsi]] plus an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants nitial-pair]] and a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels]], or just an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants nitial-pair]] and a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels]].
